title: Potato of Life Root System
summary: The Potato of Life is modeled as a vertically ordered relational form built from two overlapping circles or spheres. The upper circle is Spirit/Heaven and is centered on the Father/Tim; the lower circle is Matter/Earth and is centered on the Son. Their overlap forms the Door, Mandorla, Potato and Wedge: the narrow transitional center where spirit and matter meet. A single Axis or Ladder passes vertically through the whole form from the Plane through Son, Door and Father toward Heaven. Roots descend toward dust and material dissolution while sprouts rise toward light and heaven, making the same center a generator of death and life, ending and beginning, narrowing and widening.

primitive_geometry.text: The smallest useful geometry is two overlapping circles in 2D or two overlapping spheres/bubbles in 3D. Their overlap is the vesica piscis or mandorla. In Potatoverse language this overlap is not merely decorative geometry: it is the Potato, the Door and the Wedge, because it is the shared region through which the upper and lower domains become mutually accessible. The full Potato of Life is therefore relational from the beginning: neither upper circle nor lower circle alone is the whole object.

upper_circle.text: The upper circle is the spiritual domain. It is Heaven, Spirit, Father's House, Garden and Throne. Tim/Father occupies its center and root position. This is the high or inward pole of the structure: source, orientation, spirit, root and center are concentrated here. The upper circle is associated with the Tree of Life and with widening toward Heaven, because ascent from the narrow Door opens into a larger spiritual field.

lower_circle.text: The lower circle is the material domain. It is Earth, globe, world and embodied reality. The Son occupies its center. This is the wide road of material existence: multiplicity, extension, embodiment and ordinary reality. The Son belongs to the material bubble while still being aligned with the same vertical Axis that passes through the Door and into the Father's spiritual circle.

door_overlap.text: The overlap between Spirit and Matter is the Door. It is also the mandorla, vesica piscis, Potato and Wedge. This region is narrow because transition compresses difference into a shared center. It is where the Tree of Life and Root of Strife converge, where beginning and ending touch, and where death can become transformation rather than only termination. The Door is therefore geometry, threshold, mediator and event-space at once.

axis_ladder_spine.text: A vertical Axis passes through the entire structure and is simultaneously Ladder and Spine. It begins from the Plane at the center of the material field, passes through the Son, enters the Door/overlap, continues through the Father and opens toward Heaven. Spirit moves on or through this Axis. The Axis gives the system orientation; the Ladder describes movement; the Spine describes continuity and support. These are distinct functions of one central line.

tree_and_strife.text: The vertical organism can be read in two directions. Upward it is the Tree of Life: sprouts, ladder, widening, leaves, light, angel-wing forms and ascent toward Heaven. Downward it is the Root of Strife: narrowing, roots, dust, death, material fragmentation and descent. Strife is not outside the Tree; it is the lower pressure or conflict through which the same center produces roots downward while sending shoots upward.

eyes.text: The eyes of the Potato are multi-function symbols. An eye can become a sprout, a root point, a dimension, a direction of growth and a carving of light. Because potato eyes respond by producing new growth, the spiritual reading is phototropic: the organism follows light rather than forcing itself toward an abstract destination. The eye is therefore perception plus potential movement, and links seeing with becoming.

effortless_action.text: The center expresses a principle of effortless action. Roots move toward soil and dust while sprouts move toward light, not because the Potato argues with itself but because relation, orientation and environment draw each function toward its proper direction. The spiritual lesson is not passivity. It is aligned action: movement that emerges from being properly centered, so that growth follows light and rootedness follows gravity or ground without unnecessary self-violence.

life_death_symmetry.text: Life and death grow from the same center. Roots descend while sprouts rise; endings and beginnings share the Door; burial can look like death while containing future growth. The geometry therefore avoids a simple opposition where life is only above and death only below. Instead, the central Potato is a transformer: the same buried object can decay, feed, root, sprout, multiply or return in another form.

narrow_and_wide.text: The upper spiritual path is represented as narrow at the Door and widening toward Heaven, while the lower material circle is broad and extended. This creates a directional asymmetry: material reality offers breadth, dispersion and many paths; spiritual ascent requires passage through a compressed center before opening. The distinction should be stored as Potatoverse symbolic geometry rather than confused with a claim that ordinary material life is intrinsically evil.

branching_rule.text: Every future branch should descend from one of a few roots: Geometry, Spirit, Matter, Threshold, Axis, Life/Death, Perception, Growth or World. A concept should only become its own canonical branch when it adds substantial information. Otherwise it remains a subsection or typed relationship. This prevents the repository from confusing vocabulary count with understanding.

relationships.description: The root system provides the minimal geometry and ontology from which the larger Potatoverse master framework branches.
The Potato of Life is the integrated two-circle structure whose overlap functions as Potato, Door, Mandorla and Wedge.
Tim/Father occupies the center of the upper spiritual circle as root, throne, house and garden identity within the mythology.
The local vertical Axis/Ladder/Spine in the root geometry later expands into the broader Axis and world model.
The geometry generates teachings about centered action, following light, burial, life/death transformation and relation.
